notes: In progress 2026-09-29: starting Phase 0 Track 0A (OSR pipeline spike) on spike/0a-osr-pipeline. Environmental constraint discovered before writing code: this orchestrator runs in a headless Linux cloud container with no /dev/video* device and no macOS host, while Camera Mode is explicitly macOS-only and the spec's key unknown is macOS-specific (getUserMedia reliability in an offscreen BrowserWindow, AVFoundation-backed capture). Plan: build the real OSR spike (offscreen BrowserWindow, DOM composite, paint-event frame pacer, raw-frame dump) and drive it with Chromium's built-in synthetic fake video capture device (--use-fake-device-for-media-stream) instead of real camera hardware, since no camera exists in this container. This validates real pipeline mechanics (does getUserMedia work at all in an OSR window, does paint fire on a fake stream, can dirty-rect be forced to full-frame, does the pacer hold interval) but explicitly CANNOT validate absolute CPU numbers or real UVC/AVFoundation camera behavior on the actual target Mac mini -- that gap will be called out plainly in the journal and must be carried into 0D's decision memo as an open caveat, not silently treated as equivalent to a real-hardware measurement.
